rule.name: Markdown version of a page
rule.note: page.html.md is the page as Markdown. Only a page of a site, in the forms Jahia's own rules produce: a Markdown file of the media library (/files/...) keeps its URL.

rule.name: Markdown version of a node or of a vanity URL
rule.note: What ends in .md and is not a page address (page.html.md, above): the address of a node (about.md) or a vanity URL followed by .md. On the host of a site, Jahia's own rules have given both the same form by now, so one rule takes them and the servlet tells them apart, from the address the visitor wrote. A file of the media library, a resource of a module and Jahia's own tools keep their URL.

rule.name: Llms files of a section
rule.note: A file under the path of a page covers the pages below it: /sites/{siteKey}/home/docs/llms.txt. At least one page between the site and the file: the files of the site itself are the rules below.

rule.name: Llms full of a site
rule.note: /sites/{siteKey}/llms-full.txt serves that site's llms-full.txt, whatever the host.

rule.name: Llms of a site
rule.note: /sites/{siteKey}/llms.txt serves that site's llms.txt, whatever the host.

rule.name: Llms full
rule.note: llms-full.txt of the site whose server name is the request's host.

rule.name: Llms
rule.note: llms.txt of the site whose server name is the request's host.
